title: Final Answer on Neutrons
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly state that eta > 2 is a prerequisite for breeding.

title: Final Answer on Moderator
description: Essential Criteria: The student must accurately explain that water cannot be used as a moderator in a breeder reactor.

title: Breeder Reactor Explanation
description: Important Criteria: The student should provide a clear explanation of how a breeder reactor operates, including the roles of fissionable and nonfissionable materials.

title: Neutron Production Concept
description: Important Criteria: The student should mention the significance of neutron production in sustaining the chain reaction and breeding process.

title: Material Constraints
description: Important Criteria: The student should identify the constraints on material choice in a breeder reactor, particularly regarding neutron absorption.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as misinterpreting the role of moderators in breeding reactors.

title: Units and Definitions
description: Optional Criteria: The student may include relevant units or definitions related to neutron production and fission processes.
